Fact: distribution_channels
What to find: Methods of distribution (open weights on repositories, API, cloud platforms, apps).
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Availability, Distribution, Access

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Open model weights released on Hugging Face and ModelScope (GitHub and HF formats); code on GitHub; deployable via LMDeploy and vLLM (vLLM recommended for the 20B-A4B model); chat demo available online.
quotes: All models and code are publicly released.

> In most cases, both [LMDeploy](https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy) and [vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm) can be used for model deployment. However, for InternVL3.5-20B-A4B, we recommend using vLLM since lmdeploy has not yet supported GPT-OSS.
